name: madrasa-miftah-ul-uloom
description: Madrasa Miftah ul Uloom multilingual website, management system and Islamic bookstore

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --workspace backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --workspace backend run start" "npm --workspace frontend run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
